benign.title: Seated side by side
benign.text: They sat next to each other in 100% of shared hands (more than 100% of pairs). Position alone creates more steals and folds between neighbours.

benign.title: Too few hands to be sure
benign.text: They played only 2% of the table's hands together (fewer than 96% of pairs). A few big pots can swing every rate; treat the scores as weak evidence.

benign.title: A losing player loses to the whole table
benign.text: One player loses -103 bb per 100 hands overall (worse than 92% of pairs). Chips flowing to the partner may be part of losing to everyone.
